law: Across the tested LFM2 (64 experts), Kimi-Linear (256 experts), and GLM4 (128 experts) routed MoE organs, cross-expert sharing does not outperform matched nulls. Within-expert low-rank structure is architecture- and layer-conditional rather than a universal MoE property.
operational_effect: Do not spend body-wide budget on cross-expert shared bases, common-plus-delta, or clustering without a new causal hypothesis.
Run within-expert low-rank discriminators only after anatomy establishes a matched-null deficit above the published threshold.
Use nonlinear/generated/router-conditioned hypotheses for anatomy-negative bodies such as tested Kimi-Linear.
reopen_condition: A materially different MoE anatomy or an output-aware causal discriminator must show cross-expert sharing superiority over its matched null; a lower raw ratio alone is insufficient.
claim_boundary: Three static specimens are evidence for a scoped scheduling law, not a universal claim about all MoE models or a capability-preservation result.
